children: RNS Number : 4120W  Puma AIM VCT PLC  25 September 2026

The Company has issued a prospectus dated 25 September 2026 relating to an offer for subscription for ordinary shares of £0.01 each in the Company to raise up to £10 million with an over-allotment facility for up to a further £10 million (the "Offer"), following approval from the Financial Conduct Authority.

The Offer is now open and is expected to close no later than 5 April 2027 for shares to be allotted in the 2026/27 tax year and, if the Offer is extended beyond that date by the directors of the Company (the "Directors"), no later than 3 September 2027 for shares to be allotted in the 2027/28 tax year (unless fully subscribed by an earlier date or previously extended by the Directors to no later than 20 September 2027).
The Directors reserve the right to close the Offer earlier.

Pursuant to an offer agreement dated 25 September 2026 relating to the Offer between, among others, the Company and Puma Investment Management Limited ("PIML"), PIML, as the promoter of the Offer, will receive a promoter fee of up to 3% of the aggregate amount received by the Company under the Offer. PIML, as the investment manager of the Company, is a related party of the Company under UK Listing Rule 11.5.3R, and the payment of such a fee by the Company to PIML is a relevant related party transaction of an adequate size under UK Listing Rule 11.5.4R for UK Listing Rule 8.2.1R(1) to (4) to apply. The Board considers this transaction fair and reasonable as far as the shareholders of the Company are concerned and the Directors have been provided with written confirmation of this by the Company's sponsor, Howard Kennedy Corporate Services LLP.

A copy of the Prospectus has been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism, which is located at: and will shortly be available for viewing online at the following website address: https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism.

Copies of the Prospectus are also available free of charge from the office of the Company's investment manager, Puma Investment Management Limited, Cassini House, 57 St James's Street, London SW1A 1LD.
